assessments.reasoning: SQLite’s official guide matched its capture digest. The title and opening explicitly distinguish the SQL SQLite understands, omissions and additions. The generic guide directly supports the project-wide part of the statement.
SQLite’s versioned release log matched the expected raw digest. Its 3.46.0 heading and SQL changes directly date the separate release-specific part of the statement.

challenge.method: I compared the exact live guide’s opening with the versioned release log’s SQL additions. I checked that the guide is a project document and tested the interpretation that a general guide could alone establish 3.46.0 behavior.
challenge.results: The guide describes SQL with omissions and additions. The release log separately establishes that the selected release changed SQL constructs, including literals and SQL functions. The guide and release log share the SQLite project lineage.

limitations: Active records the catalog identity lifecycle. The general guide is bound to its captured bytes and the release log supplies its own 3.46.0 facts.
The classification concerns the language surface. It supplies no measurement of conformance or classification of the engine as a language.
